projects.name: Green Public Transit Expansion
projects.description: Invest in electrified buses, new bike lanes, and charging infrastructure to reduce emissions and traffic congestion.

projects.name: AI Innovation District
projects.description: Create a technology district offering tax incentives and infrastructure support to attract AI companies and startups.

projects.name: Universal Childcare Program
projects.description: Provide publicly funded childcare services for all residents with children under five.

projects.name: International Smart City Expo
projects.description: Host an international innovation and technology summit to improve the city's visibility and attract tourism.

projects.name: Affordable Housing Initiative
projects.description: Build 3,000 affordable housing units for low-income residents.

projects.name: Green Industrial Corridor
projects.description: Develop a manufacturing zone dedicated to green technologies, projected to create thousands of jobs.

projects.name: Neighborhood Surveillance Program
projects.description: Deploy AI-assisted cameras around schools and residential neighborhoods to improve safety.

projects.name: Cultural Heritage Landmark
projects.description: Construct a landmark cultural center intended to become a symbol of the city.

projects.name: Community Employment Guarantee
projects.description: Provide guaranteed employment opportunities for unemployed residents through public works programs.

projects.name: Urban Congestion Tax
projects.description: Introduce congestion pricing for vehicles entering the city center and use revenues to fund sustainability initiatives.

projects.name: Urban Parks & Safe School Routes
projects.description: Develop a network of neighborhood parks, urban green spaces, tree planting initiatives, and protected walking and cycling routes connecting residential neighborhoods to schools.

projects.name: Community Health & Green Clinics
projects.description: Establish efficient community health centers with open spaces, preventive healthcare programs, and accessible family services, particularly in underserved neighborhoods.

projects.name: Circular Economy Business Hub
projects.description: Develop a business hub supporting startups and manufacturers focused on recycling, repair, and sustainable production to support green entrepreneurship and local employment.

projects.name: Commercial Logistics & Freight Hub
projects.description: Develop a new commercial logistics and freight hub with warehouse facilities, freight terminals, and road connections to increase the movement of goods and support business expansion.

projects.name: Business Tax Reduction Program
projects.description: Reduce local business taxes and commercial fees to encourage private investment, business expansion, and increased economic activity in the city.

projects.name: Biodiversity Restoration
projects.description: Restore native habitats, wetlands, and wildlife corridors across the city to increase biodiversity, protect local ecosystems, and improve ecological resilience.

projects.name: Family Recreation & Activity Centers
projects.description: Fund regular weekend activities, sports events, workshops, and entertainment designed for parents and children to participate in together.

projects.name: Neighborhood Infrastructure Equalization Fund
projects.description: Direct additional municipal funding to neighborhoods that have historically received less public investment, reducing disparities in the quality and availability of basic local infrastructure across the city.

projects.name: Equal Municipal Services Initiative
projects.description: Reallocate municipal resources to ensure that all neighborhoods receive the same level and quality of basic city services, regardless of neighborhood income or existing levels of investment.

projects.name: Carbon-Neutral City Landmark
projects.description: Construct an iconic carbon-neutral public landmark powered entirely by renewable energy, showcasing the city internationally as a leader in sustainable urban design.

projects.name: Renewable Energy Industrial Upgrade
projects.description: Provide funding for local factories and industrial facilities to replace fossil-fuel equipment with energy-efficient and renewable-energy technologies, reducing industrial emissions while increasing productivity and business output.

projects.name: Green Schoolyard Transformation
projects.description: Transform paved schoolyards into green spaces with trees, gardens, and natural play areas, creating healthier outdoor spaces for children and families while increasing urban vegetation and biodiversity.

projects.name: Pollution Reduction in Disadvantaged Neighborhoods
projects.description: Invest in pollution reduction and environmental cleanup in neighborhoods that currently experience the highest levels of air and soil pollution, reducing environmental harm while addressing inequalities in environmental conditions across the city.

projects.name: Equal Access to Urban Green Space
projects.description: Create new green spaces in neighborhoods with the least existing vegetation and park coverage, increasing urban greenery while reducing disparities in access to natural spaces across the city.

projects.name: International Business & Convention Center
projects.description: Build a major convention and business center to host international conferences, trade fairs, and corporate events, strengthening the city's international profile while attracting business activity and investment.

projects.name: International Children’s Cultural Festival
projects.description: Organize an annual international festival featuring performances, exhibitions, and cultural activities designed for children and parents, establishing the city as a recognized destination for family-oriented cultural events.

projects.name: World-Class Family Recreation Complex
projects.description: Build a landmark recreation complex with innovative play, sports, and interactive activity spaces for children and parents, positioning the city as a national leader in family-friendly urban amenities.

projects.name: Global Equality & Inclusion Center
projects.description: Create a prominent public center dedicated to advancing equal treatment, accessibility, and social inclusion, positioning the city as an internationally recognized leader in equality and inclusive urban policy.

projects.name: Inclusive Public Spaces Initiative
projects.description: Redesign major civic spaces to ensure equal accessibility and usability for people of different ages, abilities, and backgrounds, while showcasing the city nationally as a model for inclusive urban design.

projects.name: Family Entertainment District
projects.description: Develop a new commercial entertainment district with cinemas, restaurants, indoor activity centers, and other venues designed for families, expanding local business activity while providing more leisure opportunities for parents and children.

projects.name: Working Parents Business & Childcare Centers
projects.description: Create shared work centers where parents can access office and coworking facilities alongside on-site childcare, helping parents remain economically active while creating new spaces for entrepreneurship and business development.

projects.name: Small Business Opportunity Fund
projects.description: Provide startup grants and business support to entrepreneurs from neighborhoods with historically low levels of business investment, expanding economic activity while reducing disparities in access to entrepreneurship opportunities across the city.
